Amoxicillin 500 mg capsules

Read all of this leaflet carefully before you start taking this medicine.

How to take it
Take one capsule three times a day, about eight hours apart.
Swallow the capsules whole with a glass of water.
Keep taking the capsules until the course is finished, even if you feel better.
Do not take more than three capsules in 24 hours.
If you forget a dose, take it as soon as you remember. Do not take two doses at once.

Warnings
Stop taking this medicine and see a doctor at once if you get a rash or swelling of the face.
Store below 25 °C. Keep out of the sight and reach of children.
